name: dangerouslySetInnerHTML renders raw HTML (XSS)
fix: Render data as text. If you must render HTML, sanitize it first with DOMPurify.sanitize() and keep the allow-list tight.

name: bypassSecurityTrust* disables Angular's sanitizer (XSS)
fix: Remove the bypass and bind with [innerHTML] so Angular sanitizes it. If unavoidable, sanitize with DOMPurify first and never pass user-controlled input.

name: dev-server host check disabled (DNS rebinding)
fix: Remove the flag and list allowed hosts explicitly (allowedHosts). Never expose a dev server publicly.

name: direct innerHTML/outerHTML assignment (XSS)
fix: Use textContent, or a framework binding that escapes by default. Sanitize with DOMPurify if HTML is required.

name: eval() / new Function() executes dynamic code
fix: Replace with JSON.parse, a lookup table, or a real parser. Add a strict Content-Security-Policy without 'unsafe-eval'.

name: document.write() (XSS, blocks parsing)
fix: Create elements with the DOM API (createElement + textContent).

name: TLS certificate verification disabled
fix: Remove it and trust the proper CA instead (NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS or the ca option).

name: auth token stored in localStorage (stolen by any XSS)
fix: Use an HttpOnly; Secure; SameSite=Lax cookie set by the server (or a backend-for-frontend) so scripts cannot read the token.

name: Html.Raw() outputs unencoded HTML (XSS)
fix: Let Razor encode the value (@Model.Value). If raw HTML is required, sanitize it with HtmlSanitizer first.

name: SQL built by string concatenation/interpolation (SQL injection)
fix: Use parameterized queries (cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue / SqlParameter), Dapper parameters, or EF Core LINQ.

name: EF Core raw SQL with string interpolation (SQL injection)
fix: Use FromSqlInterpolated / ExecuteSqlInterpolated, or pass SqlParameter objects.

name: insecure deserializer (BinaryFormatter and friends)
fix: Use System.Text.Json or DataContractSerializer with known types. BinaryFormatter is removed in modern .NET for security reasons.

name: Json.NET TypeNameHandling enables remote code execution gadgets
fix: Use TypeNameHandling.None, or a custom ISerializationBinder allow-list. Prefer System.Text.Json.

name: CORS allows any origin
fix: List trusted origins explicitly with WithOrigins(...). Never combine with credentials.

name: TLS certificate validation disabled
fix: Remove the bypass; trust the real CA via the OS store or a pinned certificate.

name: database password in connection string
fix: Use Integrated Security/managed identity, or load the password from user-secrets, environment variables or Azure Key Vault.

name: user input passed to a shell/exec function (RCE)
fix: Never pass request data to a shell. Use escapeshellarg() with a fixed allow-list of commands, or a native library.

name: unserialize() on user input (object injection / RCE)
fix: Use json_decode(), or unserialize($x, ['allowed_classes' => false]) on trusted data only.

name: eval() executes dynamic code
fix: Remove eval(); use a dispatch table or proper templating.

name: TLS certificate verification disabled
fix: Remove verify=False and point verify= at your CA bundle if you use a private CA.

name: subprocess with shell=True (command injection)
fix: Pass an argument list and leave shell=False.

name: pickle can execute code when loading untrusted data
fix: Use JSON or another data-only format for untrusted input.
